question: Which of the following is the highest peak of Western Ghats ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anamudi**__**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The** highest peak in the Western Ghats** is **Anamudi.**
 
• **Anamudi** is located in **Kerala.**
 
• **Anamudi** is the highest peak in Kerala.
 
• **Anamudi** is also known as the **Everest of South India.**
 
• **Anamudi** is the **highest peak** in **peninsular India.**
